---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Why is deterministic/specialized infrastructure the right approach?

## Proposed Capability

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Expected Behavior

How the feature should work from the user's perspective.

## Why Deterministic?

Explain why this capability should be implemented deterministically rather than relying on LLM reasoning.

## Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you considered and why they were rejected.

## Agent Integration Implications

Does this feature require changes to specific agent adapters, or is it agent-neutral?

## Testing Requirements

How should this feature be tested? What verification should be added?
